caption: The drawing depicts a single large cylindrical crock or jug, shown upright with two looped handles on opposite sides near the top. The vessel has a wide mouth with an outwardly flared rim, and the surface shows a mottled texture with brown, tan, and gray hues, suggesting a stoneware material. There are blue decorative accents on the handles. Markings on the upper part of the vessel include the number "2," the text "GOODWIN & CO HARTFORD," and an emblem featuring a central urn with floral or leaf motifs. A rectangular inset in the upper right corner provides a close-up of one of the handles, highlighting its curved form and blue accent. The drawing is surrounded by a thin rectangular border, and the artist’s signature, "FUMAGALLI," appears in the lower right outside the border. The overall composition is centered on the crock, with the detail view placed to the upper right.
title: Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
